explication: SD.Next is a cross-platform WebUI and server for generating, editing, and processing AI images and video. The documented user journey is to submit a generation or editing workflow through the interface/API, run model inference, then refine or process the result. The graph preserves README capabilities including captioning, ControlNet, LoRA, upscaling, model downloads, quantization, and installer support. Some wiring is based on README statements or SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled modules are represented at directory level, and uncertain runtime links are omitted.
